measured_over: 8 sub-millimetre shifts of the whole scene along y (realisations of EEVEE's dither), 64 by 64 frame, 16 samples, 9 by 9 patch mean. Potter's realtime render of the same scenes (the same shifts) gave patch means identical to 1e-8 at every shift.

BLENDED.derivation: EEVEE's value is constant across all 8 shifts (sigma 0). The EXR is half-float; for values in [0.5, 1) the rounding error is at most 2^-12 = 0.000244140625. Potter's realtime output is exact (sigma 0), so the tolerance is that rounding bound alone.

DITHERED.derivation: The expectation is the channel mean of the Transparent Color, (0.2 + 0.8 + 0.4) / 3. Potter asserts that expectation to f32 storage (tolerance 1e-5). EEVEE's dithered mean sits 0.00956 above it, 13 standard errors (sigma 0.00207 over 8 shifts), so it is a systematic difference and not noise: it is a known gap, not tolerated by widening the tolerance. [INFERENCE: EEVEE's dither quantises the transparency over its 16 samples, which is what the offset is consistent with; the cause is not verified in source.]
